newsitem.title: JORDAN: Jordan stocks rise above key 150-point level.
newsitem.headline: Jordan stocks rise above key 150-point level.

text.p: Jordanian stocks on Sunday breached the 150-point psychological barrier in bullish trade as investors looked ahead to continued buying impetus on select blue chips, dealers said.

The official Amman Financial Market 60-share index climbed 1.5 percent to 152.11 points, its highest level since April, in a healthy turnover of 896,498 shares worth 1.98 million dinars ($2.7 million).
Of 50 stocks traded, 32 advanced, 11 fell and seven were unchanged. One posted year lows.
Brokers said an injection of cash into the market by medium-sized funds and some foreign buying continued to buttress the market.
"There is an injection of liquidity in the market that has raised prices noticeably and buoyed sentiment that outside buying has finally arrived," said one broker.
Arab Bank led the market, with a 1.6 percent rise of 4.00 dinars to 251.00 dinars and 3,480 shares changing hands.
Other gainers were Arab Potash, Jordan Investment Finance Bank and Housing Bank and leading industrials El Zay ready-made garments.
